NuSEDS escapement records, each with the kind of evidence it is

Source: R/nuseds_records.R
knw_nuseds_records.Rd

Reads a NuSEDS All Areas release (knw_nuseds_fetch()) through crate (crate::crt_ingest("dfo", "nuseds_all_areas")), which reads whichever registered release shape arrives into one set of lower-case columns, and adds evidence_kind. Every column NuSEDS carries is kept as DFO wrote it: counts, presence, survey methods, inspections, estimate method and quality, and the arrival and spawn dates (DD-MON-YY, as written).

Usage

knw_nuseds_records(path)

Arguments

path

character(1) a NuSEDS All Areas zip or CSV.

Value

A tibble: crate's canonical NuSEDS columns and evidence_kind.

Details

One row is one estimate (act_id): a population (pop_id) on one stream (gfe_id, waterbody_id, fwa_watershed_cde) in one year. A population can be counted on several streams in a year, so a population, species and year is not a key; a population, stream and year is, and both keys are checked.

evidence_kind says what each record shows, so a reader can tell counts from judgements. It is decided from adult_presence first, then for a present population by the first of these that holds:

  • count_expert: a spawner or return number greater than 0, with the estimate method "Expert Opinion" and no survey recorded;

  • count: a spawner or return number greater than 0;

  • presence_expert: present by expert opinion, with no number and no survey recorded;

  • presence_survey: present, with a survey method or a number of inspections recorded;

  • presence_unrecorded: present, with none of the above recorded.

The other presence values give none_observed (NONE OBSERVED), not_inspected (NOT INSPECTED) and unknown (UNKNOWN or blank). A survey is recorded where enumeration_methods or no_inspections_used is filled; the number is the larger of natural_adult_spawners and total_return_to_river.

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata/examples/dfo/nuseds_all_areas_2026-06-01.csv", package = "crate")
if (nzchar(f)) {
  x <- knw_nuseds_records(f)
  table(x$evidence_kind)
  x[x$waterbody == "MAXAN CREEK" & x$evidence_kind != "not_inspected",
    c("analysis_yr", "evidence_kind", "total_return_to_river", "enumeration_methods")]
}
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   analysis_yr evidence_kind   total_return_to_river enumeration_methods
#>         <int> <chr>                           <dbl> <chr>              
#> 1        1986 none_observed                      NA NA                 
#> 2        1988 count                              50 Walk               
#> 3        1993 count                              20 Helicopter         
#> 4        2003 presence_survey                    NA Helicopter         
#> 5        2007 none_observed                      NA NA                 
#> 6        2008 presence_expert                    NA NA
